title: Characterization of Word Equality
statement: For all binary words $u$ and $v$, the prefix of $u$ of length $|v|$ equals $v$ and there is no bit of $u$ at index $|v|$ if and only if $u=v$.
replaced: For all binary strings $u$ and $v$: the length-$|v|$ prefix of $u$ equals $v$ and $u$ has no bit at index $|v|$, if and only if $u = v$.
